'''Darth Anathel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Onslaught" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was a rival of fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Xarion|Xarion]]. The two began to battle in the [[Stygian Caldera]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], but their conflict soon disrupted Imperial trade, prompting a negotiator to convince them to move their battle elsewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Blind Hatred" />

He would later rise to the position of Darth during the intervening years, and would sit on the Dark Council by [[3628 BBY]], as Head of [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine|Sith Doctrine]] - a newly created seat that oversaw the former Spheres of Mysteries, Sith Philosophy & Ancient Knowledge. His rival [[Darth Xarion]] would also be on the Council as Head of [[Sphere of Galactic Influence|Galactic Influence]].<ref name="TORweb-Jedi Under Siege: State of the Galaxy">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181130|text=Jedi Under Siege: State of the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Gameplay alternatives==
During the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion, an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Darth Nox|player character]] who is a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] could choose to demand Anathel's seat on the Dark Council back the next time they meet. In response, Anathel dismisses their claim, given that the Sith Inquisitor is no longer a member of the Dark Council nor of the Empire and thus had no grounds to challenge him. He later sends a HoloNet message to the player character, declaring his rival too feeble compared to him. Following the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]], as the Dark Council assembled on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in person, the player character proceeds to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Anathel. Alternatively, if the player does not challenge Anathel during the ''Onslaught'' prologue, his life will be spared at the end of the expansion.<ref name="Onslaught" />
